item.title: MERC Allows C&I Consumer Simultaneous Benefits of Net Metering and Open Access
item.description: In another judgment related to rooftop solar connections for the Commercial & Industrial (C&I) segment, the Maharashtra Electricity Regulatory Commission (MERC) has reiterated that net metering and open access can coexist in Maharashtra. This follows similar observations made by the state power regulator in several earlier cases. item.title: Shakti Pumps Get Off-Grid Solar Pump Orders From MP, Haryana
item.description: Indian solar pump manufacturer Shakti Pumps has announced that it has secured a new solar pump order in Haryana. In a regulatory filing, the Indore-based company stated that it has received the order from the Haryana Renewable Energy Department (HAREDA). The award comprises an order for 792 solar water pumping systems for the state. item.title: 5 Things You Should Know About the Electricity (Amendment) Rules, 2026
item.description: The Ministry of Power has recently notified the Electricity (Amendment) Rules, 2026, with the primary objective of bringing greater clarity to the regulatory framework governing captive power plants. The amendments seek to redefine the applicability of captive status, particularly for groups of companies, subsidiaries, and associations of persons. item.title: Sungrow, Solis & GoodWe Feature Among Top 10 Solar Inverter Brands In Wood Mackenzie's Report
item.description: Huawei and Sungrow emerged as the world’s leading solar inverter manufacturers in the first half of 2025, according to the Global Solar Inverter Manufacturer Rankings H1 2025 report published by Wood Mackenzie. Huawei secured the top position with a score of 93.9, closely followed by Sungrow with 93.7. item.description: Australia’s Clean Energy Council’s latest report for the third quarter (Q3) has revealed that energy storage projects continued to charge ahead, setting new records. In contrast, momentum for renewable energy investment activity slowed for large-scale electricity generation.
